items.title: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
items.snippet: As reports of OpenAI's models breaking containment, hacking sites, and generally getting out of control pile up, the company has made the decision to pause training of its most powerful models. items.title: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
